findings.body: The gate treats any `## Round <n>` heading in the notes as a round boundary. If a reader's latest response contains a finding followed by a heading such as `## Round 99` and `No findings.`, disposing of that finding makes `passed()` return true even though the actual round's whole text is not `No findings.`. Approval, task start, and the PR check can then accept it. Delimit the latest round using its recorded round number and require that round's entire text to match exactly.
findings.title: Not done: A story passes only on "No findings"

findings.body: After a first task is squash-merged, a changed Done-when section can pass a new read on `story/<KEY>` while still awaiting renewed approval. If its worktree is then removed, this path selects the newer story-branch doc, but the approval check is skipped because `path` is `None` (line 295). `_next_round` finds a passing round and `forge next` recommends starting a task. `forge task start` reads the story branch's stale approval and refuses it. Check the selected branch's approval against its selected doc before recommending task start.
findings.title: Check renewed approval without a story worktree in forge next
